title: Continuous Behavioral Authentication via Multi-Expert BERT Log Analysis for Secure Data Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2606.21900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous authentication for mobile and zero-trust systems requires nonintrusive evidence confirming the enrolled user-device context remains valid after initial login. This paper presents a BERT log analysis framework for continuous behavioral authentication using Android system logs. The proposed pipeline parses logcat streams into event templates and dynamic variables, pre-trains a domain-adapted BERT encoder on Android log syntax, and fine-tunes three expert models for network/device identity, battery-transition timing, and Wi-Fi topology. The expert confidence scores are fused through a log-space transformation and a 5-nearest-neighbor distance classifier to generate a normality score that is provided to a Policy Decision Point (PDP) for risk-aware access control. translated_title: 基于多专家BERT日志分析的连续行为认证，用于安全数据共享
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21900v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：移动和零信任系统的连续认证需要非侵入性证据，以确认初始登录后注册的用户设备上下文仍然有效。本文提出了一种基于Android系统日志的BERT日志分析框架，用于连续行为认证。所提出的流程将logcat流解析为事件模板和动态变量，在Android日志语法上预训练一个领域适应的BERT编码器，并微调三个专家模型，分别用于网络/设备身份、电池转换时序和Wi-Fi拓扑。专家置信度分数通过对数空间变换和5最近邻距离分类器融合，生成一个正常性分数，提供给策略决策点（PDP）以进行风险感知访问控制。在正常轨迹、受控异常注入和良性Wi-Fi扰动上的实验表明，多专家BERT日志分析可以检测语义和基于行为的异常。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多专家BERT日志分析框架，通过解析Android系统日志并融合网络、电池和Wi-Fi行为的专家置信度，实现连续行为认证，以增强安全数据共享中的风险感知访问控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-expert BERT log analysis framework that parses Android system logs and fuses expert confidence scores from network, battery, and Wi-Fi behaviors to enable continuous behavioral authentication, enhancing risk-aware access control for secure data sharing.
